Hot Maple Muffins
By: Stacey
Published: Wednesday, October 13, 2010 - 6:53am

Ingredients




1 egg
1/4 cup maple syrup
1 3/4 cups flour
1/4 teaspoon salt
1/4 cup milk
1/4 cup canola oil
3 teaspoons baking powder

Preparation

1 Beat egg, add milk.  In a separate bowl, combine the flour, baking powder and salt.  Add dry ingredients to milk and egg mixture alternately with the maple syrup.  Add oil.  Bake in greased muffin tins for 20 minutes at 350 degrees. 2 I served them very warm with butter and warm syrup** Once they cool they are very dry.
